gameDescriptionHtml:
In this third installment of the Whisker Wanderlust series, a peaceful day takes a magical turn. An unexpected accident sees the kitty’s owner pulled into a mysterious magic circle and vanished into an unknown world! To track them down, our cute protagonist must brave this realm filled with miracles and mysteries, following every tiny clue to find their way back to their owner.

Game Features

  • Wander Through a Vibrant Magical World – The game continues the series’ signature style with lush, hand-painted artwork. We’ve used vibrant colors and delicate brushstrokes to build a fantasy world unlike any other. Every scene is dripping with artistic romance, making it feel like you are flipping through a living, breathing picture book. Paired with memorable, atmospheric music, you’ll lose yourself in a mesmerizing interplay of light and color.
  • Embark on a Cozy Hidden Object Journey – Relax and search at your own pace! We’ve kept the classic level-based hidden object gameplay you love while adding brand-new hidden content and mechanics waiting to be unlocked. The game features 10 unique levels plus 1 hidden stage, each with a distinct theme and atmosphere. As you explore this magical realm, you’ll meet 30 new friends! They have their own stories to tell and special requests for you to fulfill, adding more fun and interaction to your journey. There are over 1,500 items scattered throughout the world – from critical clues to quirky little objects – all cleverly blended into the environment. Every level is packed with detail, offering a rich and satisfying puzzle-solving experience.
  • Surprises Hidden Along the Way – Beyond immersive exploration, we’ve designed a layered quest system to give your journey a sense of purpose and achievement. Collect gems hidden in the levels to unlock treasure chests and find puzzle fragments. Piece them together to open the gate to the Hidden Level and uncover the secrets behind this magical world! Keep your eyes peeled – we’ve also hidden plenty of clever Easter eggs throughout the scenes. Look closely, and you might find some adorable tributes to classic works!
